WHAT IS NICHESPARK
Long-tail keyword research, without copy and paste

Google Autocomplete is one of the best free sources of real search phrases, but collecting it by hand means typing a query, waiting for the dropdown and copying each suggestion, hundreds of times. NicheSpark does that loop for you, at a respectful pace, and keeps everything organized by project.

See how it compares with other free keyword research tools →

Real suggestions only

NicheSpark reads the suggestions Google actually displays in your browser. It never invents keywords or shows sample data as results.

Organized automatically

Duplicates are merged (ignoring case and extra spaces), and every keyword remembers which queries and methods found it.

Private by design

No account, no server, no tracking. Your projects and keywords are stored only in your own Chrome profile.

HOW IT WORKS
From seed keyword to keyword list in four steps
1
Create a project

Enter a seed keyword such as mobile car detailing, then choose a Google domain and language.

2
Pick a method

Choose A to Z, prefix, suffix or your own templates. You can preview every query before anything runs.

3
Click Start

NicheSpark opens Google in a background tab, enters each query and waits for the suggestion dropdown to settle before reading it.

4
Review your keywords

Results are saved after every query. Search them in the dashboard, see their sources and pick up where you left off.

TRY IT
See the queries NicheSpark would run

Type your own seed keyword. These are exactly the queries the extension generates. The suggestions themselves come from Google when you run it.

RESEARCH METHODS
Four ways to expand any niche, and a fifth on the way

Queries are generated deterministically from your seed keyword. Accidental duplicates are removed, and invalid input is caught before collection starts.

A to Z

Adds every letter after your seed to uncover the full range of completions. You can start from any letter.

mobile car detailing a
mobile car detailing b
mobile car detailing c … z
Prefix

Puts your own words before the seed to find commercial and comparison intent.

best mobile car detailing
affordable mobile car detailing
professional mobile car detailing
Suffix

Adds words after the seed to find local, pricing and service queries.

mobile car detailing near me
mobile car detailing cost
mobile car detailing services
Templates

Build your own patterns with {seed} and {letter}. A template with a letter expands to 26 queries.

how much does {seed} cost
{seed} for {letter}
is {seed} worth it
Questions COMING IN V0.3

Puts question words before your seed so Google suggests the questions people actually ask. Perfect for blog posts and FAQ sections. Arrives with the v0.3 update on the Chrome Web Store.

how mobile car detailing
what is mobile car detailing
why mobile car detailing
can mobile car detailing
FEATURES
Built for reliable, honest research
Pause, resume, cancel, retry

Full control over every collection job. Retry only failed queries, and already completed queries are skipped automatically.

Progress that survives

Progress is saved after every query. Close the popup, come back later and continue exactly where you stopped.

Respectful pacing

A configurable delay of at least 2 seconds, with random variation, between queries. Only one job runs at a time.

Honest status reporting

Each query is marked done, empty or failed, with the reason. Failures are never counted as completed.

Source tracking

See every query and method that found a keyword, when it was first and last collected, and how often it appeared.

18 Google domains

Research google.com, .co.uk, .com.pk, .co.in, .de, .com.au and more, with your choice of interface language.

Multiple projects

Keep a separate keyword collection for every niche or client. Rename, reopen or delete projects any time.

Your history stays out

Your own past searches that Google mixes into the dropdown are recognized and never saved as keywords.

Export, copy and back up

CSV for spreadsheets, one-click copy for any tool, and a JSON backup you can restore as a new project.

Filters and bulk actions

Search, filter by method or source query, sort six ways, then copy, export or delete just the keywords you selected.

Keyword grouping COMING IN V0.3

Every keyword gets a theme, such as price, local, questions or business, and recurring modifiers become one-click groups. Plan one page per group.

Ready-made lists COMING IN V0.3

Add tested prefix and suffix packs, like Pricing, Local, Commercial or Learning, in one click instead of typing modifiers by hand.

PRIVACY AND RESPONSIBLE USE
Your research stays yours

NicheSpark asks only for the permissions it needs, and it works entirely inside your browser.

Read the privacy policy →
No servers, no accounts. Keywords and projects are stored locally in your Chrome profile and are never uploaded.
Minimal access. Runs only on Google Search pages. No access to your browsing history, cookies, passwords or other websites.
Never bypasses protections. If Google asks for verification or consent, NicheSpark stops and waits for you.
Always started by you. Nothing runs in the background unless you start a collection, and you can stop it any time.
ROADMAP
What's here and what's coming

NicheSpark is in active development. These are our plans, not promises, and priorities may change based on feedback.

Questions or feedback? Message us on WhatsApp. Where do the keywords come from? From the Google Autocomplete dropdown in your own browser. NicheSpark enters each query into the Google search box, waits for the suggestions to finish loading and saves what Google displayed. It does not generate or guess keywords. Does NicheSpark show search volume or keyword difficulty? No. NicheSpark collects autocomplete suggestions, which show what people search for, but it does not invent volume or difficulty numbers. You can take your list to the keyword metrics tool of your choice. Why might my results differ from someone else's? Google personalizes suggestions by location, language, sign-in state and trends. NicheSpark records exactly what Google showed your browser at that moment. Will Google block me? NicheSpark uses conservative delays and runs one query at a time, the way a person would. If Google shows a verification page anyway, the job stops and waits for you. It never tries to get around it. Please use NicheSpark responsibly and in line with Google's terms. Is my data uploaded anywhere? No. Everything is stored locally in your Chrome profile. NicheSpark has no server and sends your research nowhere.
